Disclosure  to  Promote  the  Right  To  Information 

Whereas  the  Parliament  of  India  has  set  out  to  provide  a  practical  regime  of  right  to 
information  for  citizens  to  secure  access  to  information  under  the  control  of  public  authorities, 
in  order  to  promote  transparency  and  accountability  in  the  working  of  every  public  authority, 
and  whereas  the  attached  publication  of  the  Bureau  of  Indian  Standards  is  of  particular  interest 
to  the  public,  particularly  disadvantaged  communities  and  those  engaged  in  the  pursuit  of 
education  and  knowledge,  the  attached  public  safety  standard  is  made  available  to  promote  the 
timely  dissemination  of  this  information  in  an  accurate  manner  to  the  public. 


Mazdoor  Kisan  Shakti  Sangathan 
"The  Right  to  Information,  The  Right  to  Live''

3«  D«signmtion 

3.1  A  mori«  taper  ihtnk  twist  dr^t  with  9  00  mm  dlamecer»  of  *  tool  typ«  ' /V  for  right-hand  cutting, 
conforming  to  this  sundard  and  mada  from  high  spead  steal  (HS)  shall  be  designated  as: 

Twist  Drill  9  00  IS:  5103  HS. 

3.2  When  required  with  *  tool  types'  other  than  Nf  H  or  S  should  be  added  In  the  designation  after  the 
diameter  as  appropriate. 

4.  Tolerancoa  — The  flute  length  /,  and  overall  length  /  may  vary  between  the  corresponding  lengths 
specified  for  the  preceding  and  the  following  ranges  of  diameters  {/.  If  the  next  larger  or  smaller  overall 
length  h  issoclated  with  a  different  taper  shank  from  that  of  the  length  under  question,  then  the  permissible 
upper  or  lower  limit  shall  be  that  of  the  next  larger  or  smaller  overall  length  minus  or  plus  the  difference 
between  the  lengths  of  the  taper  shanks  concerned. 

Example: 

The  flute  length  /i  for  1400  mm  diameter  may  vary  between  the  values  101  and  1 14  mm 
from  the  specified  value  of  108  mm.    The  overall  length  /  may  vary  between  the  values  182  and 
1775  mm  (  212  mm  mlnusl4fmm  )  from  the  specified  value  of  189  mm. 

5.  General  Requiremeitts 

5J  '  Tool  type  '  unless  otherwise  specified  :  N  according  to  IS  :  5099-1969*. 

5.2  The  detailed  dimensions  of  the  point  and  cutting  angles  shall  be  at  the  discretion  of  the  manufacturer 
{see also  IS  :  5099-1969*  for  recommendations  regarding  '  tool  types*). 

5.3  The  diameter  d  shall  be  measured  as  near  the  point  as  practicable. 

5.4  The  flute  length,  overall  length  and  tolerances  for  Intermediate  diameter  shall  be  selected  from  the 
relevant  range  of  diameters. 

5.5  Other  requirements  according  to  IS  :  5099-1969*. 

6.  Teitf  —  According  to  1$:  5099-1969*. 


EXPLANATORY    NOTE 

This  j^tandard  was  based  on  tSO/R  235-1661  which  has  been  reviewed  by  ISO  and  found 
technically  suitable  for  transformaticn  into  ISO  235/1-1975.  Recently  this  Indian  Standard  has  also 
been  reviewed  and  found  to  be  technically  identical  with  ISO  235/M975  'Parallel  shank  twist  drills. 
Jobber  and  stub  series,  morse  taper  shank  twist  drills  and  core  drills'  issued  by  the  International 
Organization  for  Standardization.
